title: Typing practice: send an email
drDigitalIntro:
Now let's put everything together by typing a real email.
• You will open the Mail app, write a message, and send it — just like on a real computer.
• The email uses capital letters (Shift), a question mark (?), an exclamation mark (!), and commas inside a big number.
• Capital letters need Shift: hold Shift and tap the letter at the same time.
• Commas and punctuation are on the keyboard — look to the right of the letters.
• Take your time — accuracy matters more than speed.

playgroundTask.goal: Send an email to Dr. Digital

steps.say: Click the pencil icon to compose a new email.
Type the subject: Hi Dr. Digital!
Type the message: Hi Doctor Digital! Are you having a good day today? Thanks for teaching me like 9,003,751 new things!
steps.value: Hi Doctor Digital! Are you having a good day today? Thanks for teaching me like 9,003,751 new things!

steps.say: Click Send to send the email.

drDigitalSuccess: Perfect! Capitals, numbers, commas, question mark, exclamation mark — you nailed every part. That is a real email, sent the real way.
drDigitalHint: Match it exactly: capital H, D, and D; commas inside 9,003,751; ? and ! Use Shift for capitals and the ! symbol.
